title: Coast Guard, agency partners help Boy Scouts become rescuers of tomorrow
description: Members of the Coast Guard, Alaska Mountain Rescue Group and MAT+SAR search and rescue K9 unit were on hand Sept. 7th, 2013, to help boy scouts at the Eklutna Fall Campboree near Trappers Creek, Alaska, become the rescuers of tomorrow by earning their search and rescue merit badges.  More than 100 boys attended the event in and participated in a simulated search and rescue case. U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 1st Class Shawn Eggert.
keywords: community outreach, Sector Anchorage, D17, eggert, Richard Whitney, SAR, search and rescue, Boy Scouts
